name: Farmer's Walk (Weighted)
instructions: Set up for the Farmer's Walk (Weighted) with dumbbells. Pick the weight up with a flat back and braced core.
Stand tall — ribs down, shoulders back — and walk with short, steady steps.
Keep your torso still and level; do not lean away from the load. Set the weight down with control.
longevityNotes: Carrying is the most functional strength there is — groceries, luggage, a grandchild. Loaded carries build grip, posture, and core stability in one movement.
overview: Farmer's Walk (Weighted) is a intermediate carry exercise for the forearms and upper back, performed with dumbbells.
